items.headline: PJ Martin scores two 4th-quarter TDs and South Alabama rallies for 40-35 win over Southern Miss
items.description: — PJ Martin rushed for a pair of touchdowns in the fourth quarter when South Alabama scored 21 points and rallied for a 40-35 win over Southern Miss on Saturday night to become bowl eligible.

items.headline: Trae’von Dunbar has 153 yards rushing and 2 TDs, South Alabama beats Troy 27-14
items.description: — Trae’von Dunbar had 153 yards rushing and two touchdowns on 14 carries to help South Alabama beat Troy 27-14 on Saturday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
